maintenance_led.reason: Sells EXPAREL, ZILRETTA and iovera pain products used in new surgeries and treatments; not repair or aftermarket servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes from hospitals, surgery centers and clinics buying EXPAREL and ZILRETTA, funded mostly by commercial insurers and mixed payers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling its commercial non-opioid products (EXPAREL, ZILRETTA) and developing a pipeline; acquisitions are occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Surgeons can choose alternative analgesics, including opioids and other local anesthetics, though the products have clinical protocols and some switching friction.

notes: Payer mix and switching difficulty are judged from general knowledge of the products rather than the website text.
